feature: GitHub and Azure DevOps backlog triage
gating: Run layers in order; do not start a layer until every case in the preceding layer passes. Keep checkpoint gates in checkpoint order.

unit.case: Explicit URLs take precedence over remotes; unique remotes resolve scope, while conflicting, incomplete, or Azure Server targets need an answer or fail closed.
Process state categories, not fixed state names, determine terminal items; batch partitioning never exceeds 200 IDs.
Untrusted HTML values are escaped and evidence links are accepted only when valid HTTPS URLs.

integration.case: A deterministic static instruction-contract check verifies separate complete GitHub issue/PR inventories and pagination, per-item analysis, evidence, ranking, read-only rules, existing report-template coverage, and no active remote mutation commands; it does not execute a synthetic provider run.
Ambiguous provider or scope is resolved before any request; a fake adapter records zero reads until an answer is available.

Azure collection reads only the selected backlog level, includes all nonterminal process categories, keeps related hierarchy as context, and emits only allowlisted read routes with explicit organization and project.
Synthetic Azure inventory crosses pagination and batch boundaries completely; capped/incomplete results, missing state metadata, unknown categories, auth errors, and API errors fail closed.
A complete synthetic inventory renders all items or UNASSESSED status, correct totals and linkages, provider-specific sections in the shared shell, and at most five concurrent analyses.
Hostile fields remain inert, invalid links are rejected, and any collection or render failure leaves the previous report byte-for-byte unchanged.
